versions.changelog:
frontend-design-deslop 1.1.0

- Added a directive for using the question tool for all user questions, including fallback instructions if no question tool exists.
- Updated compatibility metadata to include Codex and revised surrounding prose for clarity.
- Tightened and reorganized "Asking questions" guidance with concrete steps.
- Removed redundant in-text repetition about AskUserQuestion (“CRITICAL” section merged/simplified).
- skill-card.md has been removed as part of documentation cleanup.
- Minor editorial improvements for conciseness and instructions.

Initial release – introduces a strategy-first approach to distinctive, non-generic frontend UI design and de-slopification.

- Prioritizes understanding project type, audience, and personality before any visual decision-making.
- Requires commitment to 3–5 brand adjectives and a concise aesthetic essence to drive design direction.
- Converts strategy into a full design system: typography, color, token tables, and signature moves.
- Mandates the use of structured user questioning via tools, never plain text queries.
- Details a phased workflow: discovery → system definition → craft-layer application for layouts, components, and accessibility.
- Provides references, protocols, and checklists to ensure consistently high-quality, original UI results.
